_comment: Single source of truth for FSLabs Academy cohort and course data. Read by app/training/page.tsx AND scripts/build-brochures.mjs, so the site and the downloadable brochures can never disagree on a price, topic, or date. Change a price here and re-run `node scripts/build-brochures.mjs`. Track names, order, start date and benefits follow the Academy poster.
